description: Image Description: The image depicts a serene pastoral scene featuring three horses grazing in a lush green field. The horses are positioned in a line, with their heads lowered to the grass, feeding peacefully. They appear to be of similar brown coloration, with one horse slightly darker than the others. The field is vibrant and well-lit by natural sunlight, suggesting a daytime setting with clear weather. Surrounding the field are dense clusters of tall trees with rich green foliage, creating a natural border and providing shade
